highlights: ideal first time buy or investment
description:
Fully refurbished and available with no onward chain. This immaculate home has newly fitted kitchen and bathroom. The property is ideal for both investors and first time buyers and also benefits from two reception rooms, additional downstairs w/c and easy access to both Spennymoor and Bishop Auckland town centres. Also having newly fitted boiler, central heating system and a full re-wire, the property has been comprehensively refurbished throughout. The property is also situated within close proximity to local amenities, including the local leisure centre and good local schools. Entered via composite front door, the entrance hallway gives access to the downstairs accommodation. The living room to the front is a spacious area and has archway leading through to the dining room to the rear. There is further access to the kitchen and downstairs w/c. The kitchen is a good sized room which has been refitted with units and wooden worktop. The w/c has toilet, sink and worktop area providing a good utility space. To the first floor, the landing area gives access to three bedrooms and the bathroom. Two of the bedrooms are spacious double rooms and the third is a good sized single. The bathroom is again a good sized room and has been fully refurbished with tiling, three piece suite and storage cupboard. Outside to the front the property has ample on street parking. To the rear the property benefits from enclosed courtyard with side gate.

RECEPTION HALLWAY Entered via composite door, with staircase to the first floor and access to the ground floor accommodation.

KITCHEN Good sized galley style kitchen with window and door to the side. Refurbished and fitted with light grey units, wooden worktop, sink unit, integrated oven and hob with extractor above. There is also space for a breakfast style table.

UTILITY ROOM / W/C With worktop and space for appliances below. Also with window to the side, extractor fan and fitted with toilet and sink unit.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING With access to the upstairs accommodation.

BEDROOM ONE Double room with window to the front.

BEDROOM TWO Further double room with window to the rear.

BEDROOM THREE Single room with window to the front.

BATHROOM Good sized room with window to the side and storage cupboard. Refurbished and partially tiled with chrome towel radiator, bath with screen and overhead shower, sink with storage unit below and toilet.

EXTERNALLY Outside to the front the property has ample on street parking. To the rear the property benefits from enclosed courtyard with side gate.
